title: Beacon Threat Rules catalog
description: A *.catalog.yaml file of a rule pack (threat-rules/v1.3): a reviewed list of stores that the predicates it names test membership of. Path-pattern syntax, unique ids, kinds that exist, at least one example per pattern, and the examples themselves are enforced by an engine, not by this structural schema.

catalog.description: The file's identity; two files of a pack must not declare the same one.

spec.description: Minimum Threat Rules spec version the file needs. Engines set aside a file whose spec is newer than they support, as they do a rule.

predicates.description: The names a rule calls the catalog by; each is optional.

path.description: True for a path that is one of the stores of files.

command.description: True for a parsed command that reads one of the stores of commands.

mention.description: True for a text that names one of the stores of files.

redacted.description: True for a command line in which redaction replaced the name of a command that reads one of the stores of commands.

tier.description: definite: exists to hold what the catalog is of, or hands it over. likely: often does and often does not.

match.description: Path patterns of the paths that are the store.

exclude.description: Path patterns of the paths among them that are not.

name.description: A pattern component for the command's name.

words.description: Words that follow each other in this order after the name.

flags.description: Options of which one must be there.

commands.description: The commands that read the store.

examples.description: Paths or command lines that are this store; one for each match pattern and each command.

counterexamples.description: Paths or command lines that are no store of the catalog; one for each exclude pattern.
